events.title: Pope Leo Announces Lung Nodule Surgery at Sunday Angelus
events.detail: During his Sunday noon blessing, Pope Leo XIV said a small, localized nodule had been found in his lung at a very early stage during a recent medical check. He said that on the doctors' advice he had decided to have it removed, thanked the crowd and asked for prayers. The Vatican said surgery would take place in the first days of the week at Rome's Gemelli hospital, with about a week of recovery expected.

events.title: Italian PM Meloni Voices Personal and Government Support
events.detail: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni expressed her personal support and that of the Italian government as Leo faced the procedure, and said his calm manner in discussing it was reassuring.

events.title: Vatican Cancels All Papal Audiences Through October 20
events.detail: The Vatican canceled all of Pope Leo's audiences through October 20 to allow for surgery and recovery. A planned Nov. 6-17 trip to Uruguay, Argentina and Peru had not been cancelled as of reporting; Leo had said he planned to go.

events.title: Pope Leo Enters Gemelli Hospital and Undergoes Lung Surgery
events.detail: Pope Leo walked into Rome's Gemelli hospital through the main entrance and waved to well-wishers. A team led by chief thoracic surgeon Dr. Stefano Margaritora removed the lower lobe of his right lung using video-assisted surgery, to ensure a radical resection. He was in the operating room about three hours; the operation lasted about 90 minutes.

events.title: Vatican Bulletin Confirms Lung Adenocarcinoma; Surgery Successful
events.detail: The Vatican's medical bulletin said preoperative tests suggested and intraoperative histological examination confirmed lung adenocarcinoma. It said the surgery was successful with no complications and that Leo regained consciousness normally and returned to a room on Gemelli's 10th floor (the papal apartment there is being renovated). The Vatican did not disclose the stage, whether the cancer had spread, or whether further treatment is needed.
